name: Thomas Vidick
one_sentence_summary: Thomas Vidick leads the QCC Lab at EPFL, working at the intersection of quantum complexity theory, interactive proof systems, quantum error correction, and the stability of group representations.
matrix_summary: Thomas Vidick (QCC Lab) has a notable new result: "Achieving Perfect Completeness for One- and Two-Message Quantum Proof Systems" (arXiv:2609.15926, with Yupan Liu, Sep 2026), which resolves decade-old open problems by showing QMA, QAM, and QIP(2) can achieve perfect completeness. Additionally, his earlier quantum PCP work was accepted at CCC 2026.
